threads.body: [General] This breaking-change note omits removal of the appender's transitive `opentelemetry-log4j-context-data-2.17-autoconfigure` dependency. Existing standalone users relying on it for Log4j layout trace/span IDs will silently lose those fields after upgrading unless they add it explicitly, so include that migration step in the release notes.

threads.body: [Testing] This rewrite no longer supplies any of the removed `trace_id`, `span_id`, or `trace_flags` keys, so it would still pass if the legacy fallback were accidentally restored. Since ignoring those keys is the breaking behavior in this PR, add a case that populates the legacy declarative keys and verifies all three getters retain their defaults (or use the replacement values).

threads.body: [Config] This migration note covers only the flat properties, but this PR also removes the stable declarative keys `java.common.logging.trace_id`, `span_id`, and `trace_flags` and stops reading them. Document their `_key` replacements as well so file-based configuration users have an actionable 3.0 migration path.

 ### ⚠️ Breaking changes
 
+- Remove Log4j appender correlation reconstructed from trace-ID, span-ID, and
+  trace-flags strings.
+  For standalone asynchronous logging, configure
+  `log4j2.ContextDataInjector=io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.log4j.appender.v2_17.OpenTelemetryAppenderContextDataInjector`
+  to carry the full OpenTelemetry context; Java agent correlation remains supported.
+  The appender no longer brings in

+  `.trace-flags` with `.trace-id-key`, `.span-id-key`, and `.trace-flags-key`,
